selection_rule: Retain joint_pruning3 against pruning3 and anchor42; prioritize only with improvement and quality against mixed6 too. Retain and prioritize joint_mixed6 with improvement against mixed6 and anchor42 plus quality on all three comparisons. Select lowest NLL among qualifying candidates, ties by registered member order; otherwise keep mixed6. Preserve blocked comparison residuals even for an alternative retained on its own branch.
limitations: Fixed one-bundle historical research; not an estimate from independent ensemble replicates.
Completed individually calibrated/tilted predictor marginals are mixed. This is a different procedure from100 raw-softmax mean followed by ensemble-specific OOF calibration.
All three heads use the same equal weights and member order. No normalization, clipping or Harville reconstruction after averaging.
The v4 transferred-noise interval keeps k_seeds=1 and makes no ensemble variance shrinkage claim. Ensemble-specific retraining, gamma-refit and selection uncertainty is not fully measured.
Three/six members are not independent three-seed bundle replicates; six members share three learning seeds.
Eight historical exploratory intervals are not simultaneous confirmation or unused-period evidence.
No production activation, annual slot, learned ensemble weight or new calibrator. A serving candidate needs its own calibration/OOF evaluation and full procedure validation.
Conditional follow-up after119/120 on the same historical population; the observed component gains are not added together.
Only pruning members receive119 joint seasonal correction. Anchor members keep frozen118 gap-only correction.
Alternative retention for joint_pruning3 does not clear a blocked mixed6 comparison; all such failures remain explicit.
No new booster or correction-coefficient fit and no tuning of weights or members.
